name: thimble
description: Interactive cards of your data, citations a second Claude checks against your files, and explainers and heads-ups on each answer.

minimal.title: Minimal mode
minimal.description: Plain answers; cards only when you ask; the rest off.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: auto: Claude draws charts and tables of your data. on demand: Claude draws a card only when you ask for one. Press v for the last answer. off: no cards.

squeezeAnswers.title: Simplify
squeezeAnswers.description: A shorter, plainer version of the last answer.

catchUp.title: Catch-up
catchUp.description: One note on the replies that came in while you were away.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: auto + verify: Claude cites what each answer rests on. The verifier checks every citation after each answer. auto: Claude cites what each answer rests on. The verifier checks a citation when you open it. manual: select words and press c. The verifier checks them against your files. off: no citations.

checkerModel.title: Verifier model
checkerModel.description: The model of the verifier, which checks citations. same as Claude: the model of the conversation. Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.2: that model, which reads the conversation without the cache of the conversation's model.

checkerEffort.title: Verifier effort
checkerEffort.description: How hard the verifier thinks. same as Claude: the effort of the conversation. low, medium, high, xhigh or max: that effort, of the levels Claude Code offers for the verifier's model.

explain.title: Explainers
explain.description: auto: short notes on terms you may not know. on demand: select words and press e for a short note. off: no explainers.

details.title: Heads-ups
details.description: auto: notes on details that may mislead. off: no heads-ups.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The labels Claude made, with their values and records. off: no Labels pane, and Claude makes no labels.

claimsMode.title: Claims
claimsMode.description: auto: everything the session concluded. on demand: everything the session concluded, when you press f in the pane. off: no Claims pane.
